pack_name: Soravo Fresh Commercial Release Engineering Pack
revision_note: 1.1.0 applied the owner-approved decision memo SORAVO_DECISION_MEMO_2026-10-22.md: recorded the fresh website rebuild strategy with production-site preservation (ADR-0008), the CI-before-rename ordering (ADR-0009), the production domain cutover and rollback requirements (27_PRODUCTION_CUTOVER_AND_ROLLBACK.md), the corrected CrispASR packaging audit finding, and consistent PROPOSED/ACCEPTED ADR statuses (ADR-0003, ADR-0005, ADR-0010). 1.2.0 adds the mandatory Git worktree policy (28_GIT_WORKTREE_POLICY.md): one task, one worktree, one named branch; isolation from other worktrees; tests and review before integration; worktree and build-output cleanup after merge. 1.3.0 resolves the CodeRabbit review on pull request #13: the Phase 0/Phase 1 packaging-gate conflict is resolved with a documented failing-baseline exception; the cutover data rollback no longer prescribes an unqualified snapshot restore; Linux is marked BLOCKED because no Linux engine artifact exists; and the packaging claims, .gitattributes wildcard, detached-worktree rationale, incident-response wording, checksum command example, R2 eligibility, redirect definition, rollback rehearsal, payment test environment and handoff template are all corrected.

owner_decisions.platform_status_note: Linux remains an owner-approved launch target but is BLOCKED: the repository tracks a Windows CrispASR engine only. Task P1-05 must obtain, license, track and bundle a Linux engine. A Linux VERIFICATION build is permitted once P1-05 delivers the engine, because the Linux release gate cannot be satisfied without one; PUBLISHING a Linux artifact, and describing Linux as supported, stay prohibited until that whole gate passes.
owner_decisions.website: same repo, website subdirectory, independent package
owner_decisions.backend_function_placement: DECIDED - Supabase Edge Functions (ADR-0003, 2026-10-23). Cloudflare Pages hosts static website only.

memo_decisions_2026_10_22.website_strategy: rebuild fresh; historical repository is behavioral/content reference only; implementation, schema, migrations and Edge Functions are not ported
memo_decisions_2026_10_22.repository_rename_order: baseline CI and release-packaging checks first, then rename checklist, then rename, then post-rename verification
memo_decisions_2026_10_22.production_domain: soravo.xyz and its DNS and email configuration preserved until cutover; cutover is separately approved and reversible
memo_decisions_2026_10_22.crispasr_packaging_finding: third-party/bin is git-ignored with no tracked files; the engine is committed at third-party/crispasr/extracted/crispasr-windows-x86_64-cpu; bundle.resources and bundle.externalBin are empty; a clean-machine install proving engine launch is a release blocker
memo_decisions_2026_10_22.crispasr_packaging_authorization: ADR-0010 (PROPOSED - bundled layout not yet decided)

open_decisions.binary_distribution_host: PROPOSED - separate public soravo-releases repository is the preferred candidate but not settled; task P8-00; ADR-0005
open_decisions.crispasr_bundled_layout: PROPOSED - bundle.resources mapping vs externalBin sidecar vs renamed tracked staging directory; task P1-03; ADR-0010

git_worktrees.rule: Every new feature or independent task runs in its own dedicated Git worktree and named branch. One task, one worktree, one branch. Tests and review happen in the worktree before integration. Other worktrees' files, branch, index and stash are never touched. After integration the worktree, its registration and its build output are removed.

note: Documentation reconciliation only. No repository rename, DNS change, Cloudflare production change, deployment, Supabase data change, secret operation or application source modification was performed. Implementation has not started.
